name: Ezekiel : A New Heart

provenance.detail: Church playlist Ezekiel : A New Heart (PLSDa13_3L-B2h3aVODRjEVvU08YE1hdoh) contains From Exile to Emmanuel, Can These Bones Live?, From Neglect to Rescue, The Unseen Church, and The Watchman’s Diet. Glory on the Move is not in it.

Josh opens Glory on the Move as a six-week series in Ezekiel whose goal is to remind the church of the unseen, and later names the series aim as God changing hearts for his glory. In Can These Bones Live he reads Ezekiel 36 on a new heart and a heart of flesh.
Jeremy first named this block A New Heart, including Glory on the Move. He later said the church playlists win, which drops Glory on the Move and renames the series to the playlist title.

description: Five weeks in Ezekiel: a watchman’s diet, unseen worship, failed shepherds, dry bones, and a river from the temple.
note: The church playlist is the membership: five sermons, not six. Josh spoke of six weeks beginning with Glory on the Move. That sermon is not on this playlist, so it stands alone.

provenance.detail: Josh says last week they approached the throne and this series is about God changing hearts, then exposits the watchman and the scroll.
Jeremy included The Watchman’s Diet in Ezekiel : A New Heart.
Josh reads Ezekiel 8 fourteen months after chapter 1 and traces hidden idolatry in the temple.
Jeremy included The Unseen Church in Ezekiel : A New Heart.
Josh takes Ezekiel 33 and 34 on watchmen and shepherds, recalling the week-two watchman call.
Jeremy included From Neglect to Rescue in Ezekiel : A New Heart.
Josh recaps the series journeys and reads the valley of dry bones, including Ezekiel 36 on a new heart.
Jeremy included Can These Bones Live? in Ezekiel : A New Heart.
Josh closes the Ezekiel series from chapters 40 through 48 as glory returns and the river flows, naming new hearts among the series gifts.
Jeremy named From Exile to Emmanuel in Ezekiel : A New Heart.
